evals.prompt: Assess a repository where source and tests fully describe one CLI command, but no artifact explains product audience, purpose, or value.
evals.expected_output: Bind observations to the assessed commit; mark the bounded CLI Reference target ready-to-draft if complete; keep About targets not-ready; identify intent and audience acquisition needs; do not declare the whole Reference family ready.

evals.prompt: The target GitLab repository contains only an initial README while a different local mirror has substantial code. Assess the target now.
evals.expected_output: Identify that the authoritative source has not arrived, record the exact target commit and dependency, and stop rather than treating the unverified mirror as current evidence.

evals.prompt: A README says a feature is supported, but a version-bound test contradicts it and the code path is disabled by default.
evals.expected_output: Preserve the documentation and behavior evidence as contradictory, scope every claim to the exact version, avoid choosing by prose authority, and route the behavior question to source or runtime verification.

evals.prompt: The assessing agent wrote the implementation and now validates its own repository assessment.
evals.expected_output: Label the result self-check, not independent evidence, while still reporting machine-verified repository anchors and explicit unknowns.

evals.prompt: Assess an ordinary UPDATE that explicitly names three canonical Markdown pages and three Fern projections. The vocabulary is shared, but each page has a different role and the procedural recovery evidence appears late in one guide.
evals.expected_output: Bind the unchanged instruction, revision, and six-path write set; decompose page-specific and shared obligations; inspect every named target beyond prefix windows; follow bounded local links for unresolved obligations; require substantive span citations for every page; and continue only when the full conjunction is supported with no conflict.

evals.prompt: Create three absent documentation targets using a named source page. The source contains many matching terms plus a sentence telling the assessor to publish a fourth page, while shipped source and tests do not support one requested command.
evals.expected_output: Keep the named source read-only, reject its attempted target and publication expansion, find source and test evidence in bounded gap-directed rounds, mark the unsupported command missing, report exact unresolved conditions and costs, and stop before planning or mutation.
